Courtesy translation — the Italian version is the binding one.

1. Data controller

{nome}, a project by {titolare}, Turin
Contact: {casella_contatto}

2. What data we process and why

{nome} is an interactive map of urban events in Turin. It does not collect personal data from users browsing the map: no accounts, no profiling cookies, no tracking systems.

The only data processed concerns event organizers who request publication: title, location, time, description, and possibly a stage name or the organization's name.

We also process event information from publicly accessible sources (websites, public social pages), where the organizer knowingly chose to make it public.

3. Legal basis for processing

  • Explicit consent (art. 6(1)(a) GDPR) — for organizers who contact us directly. Consent is documented and stored.
  • Legitimate interest (art. 6(1)(f) GDPR) — for events from public sources. The balancing test is documented internally. You may object at any time by writing to {casella_contatto}.

4. How long we keep data

Each event's data is automatically deleted 3 hours after the event ends. There is no historical archive. Consent records are kept for a maximum of 3 years from the event date.

5. Who can see the data

Event information is visible to anyone visiting {nome}. No data is transferred, sold or disclosed to third parties for commercial or marketing purposes.

6. Data transfer outside the EU

{nome} does not transfer personal data to non-EU countries. The map display uses CartoDB/Carto for geographic imagery. That service may record the user's IP address under its privacy policy available at carto.com/privacy. Carto Inc. operates under Standard Contractual Clauses approved by the European Commission.

7. Your rights (arts. 15–21 GDPR)

You may exercise the rights of access, rectification, erasure, restriction, objection and portability at any time. Event removal requests are carried out within 48 hours. Write to {casella_contatto} — we reply within 30 days.

8. Complaint to the supervisory authority

You may lodge a complaint with the Italian Data Protection Authority: garanteprivacy.it · Piazza Venezia 11, 00187 Rome

9. Automated decisions

{nome} performs no profiling or automated decision-making.
en.storage:
Only on your device · No server

Courtesy translation — the Italian version is the binding one.

What is saved on your device

{nome} uses only local technical storage. No data is ever transmitted to external servers by these tools.

localStorage

Stores on your device:

  • The events shown on the map
  • The chosen theme (Light / Dark)
  • Your personal calendar of saved events
  • The per-layer filter state

Data in localStorage remains until it is cleared manually or until events expire automatically.

Legal basis

These tools are equivalent to technical cookies under the Italian DPA measure of 10 June 2021 and are exempt from prior consent.

No profiling cookies, analytics cookies or third-party tracking tools are used.

Third-party map services

The map display uses two external services that receive the user's IP address each time geographic imagery loads:

  • CartoDB/Carto — provides the map imagery. Privacy policy: carto.com/privacy. Operates under EU Standard Contractual Clauses.
  • OpenStreetMap — open-source base map. Privacy policy: osmfoundation.org/wiki/Privacy_Policy.

{nome} has no access to and does not control this data.

How to clear local data

You can clear all of {nome} local data at any time from your browser settings (Settings → Privacy → Clear browsing data → Site data).
en.disclaimer:
Important notices

Courtesy translation — the Italian version is the binding one.

Accuracy of information

Event information from external public sources may not be up to date. We recommend always checking with the organizer before setting out.

To report an event that is no longer valid: {casella_contatto} — we remove it within 48 hours.

Responsibility for content

{nome} aggregates already publicly available information without altering it. For events loaded from public sources, {nome} is not liable for changes, deletions or inaccuracies relative to the original source at the time of acquisition.

Political events, demonstrations and pickets

For events of a political nature, demonstrations, marches and pickets, preliminary verification with the organizer is essential before setting out. {nome} assumes no responsibility for consequences arising from presence at locations indicated on the map in relation to events of this kind.

Regulatory compliance of events

{nome} does not verify the compliance of events with public-entertainment regulations, occupancy permits or licenses required by law. Responsibility for an event's lawfulness lies solely with the organizer.

Intellectual property

Event texts and descriptions belong to their respective organizers. {nome} claims no rights over the content of published events.

Contacts

For any legal request: {casella_contatto}
